title: BOTO Daily English
author: BOTO Daily
description:
BOTO Daily | AI Daily Intelligence System
BOTO Daily is an AI-powered Global Decision Intelligence platform produced and supervised by the Zhiweizi Team.
Our goal is not to report every piece of news. Every day, we filter a vast amount of global information and identify the developments that truly matter to the economy, financial markets, global liquidity, and digital assets — helping you understand what matters and make better decisions in just five minutes.
【WHAT BOTO DAILY MONITORS EVERY DAY】
1. Global Risk
U.S.–Iran relations, U.S.–Israel military activity, Middle East tensions, the Strait of Hormuz, Red Sea shipping, global energy supply, and other major geopolitical risks that may affect global financial markets.
2. U.S. Economy & Global Liquidity
CPI, PPI, PCE, Non-Farm Payrolls, unemployment, GDP, PMI/ISM, retail sales, FOMC decisions, Federal Reserve policy, and important speeches by Fed officials.
We also monitor the Japanese yen, U.S. Treasury markets, the U.S. dollar, and other important liquidity signals that could trigger major shifts in global capital flows.
3. Bitcoin Core Data
Bitcoin price and market direction;
USDT, USDC, and total stablecoin supply;
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF flows;
BTC exchange reserves;
Realized Price and the market’s average cost basis;
Short-Term Holder Cost Basis;
Long-Term Holder Cost Basis and accumulation or distribution;
Bitcoin’s correlation with U.S. equities;
CryptoQuant 30-day Spot Demand, Futures and Perpetual Demand, and Total Demand.
Together, these indicators help us understand Bitcoin’s real liquidity, supply-demand structure, and market cost basis.
4. Ethereum
We monitor ETF flows, major network upgrades, regulatory developments, and significant ecosystem changes.
5. AI · Web3 · BOTO Industry Intelligence
We focus on meaningful developments in artificial intelligence, Hyperliquid, Web3, data products, automation, and decision intelligence — including product innovation, user growth, funding, partnerships, and technological developments worth watching.
6. Major Global Developments
Every day, we select one or two major developments that could affect the global economy, financial markets, energy, supply chains, technology, AI, or global capital flows.
These developments are not limited to our regular monitoring categories. If an event is important enough, BOTO Daily will follow it.
【OUR DAILY PRINCIPLE】
We monitor our core indicators every day, but we do not repeatedly discuss data that has not meaningfully changed.
If there is no significant change, we simply state that it remains unchanged.
Every episode focuses on four questions:
What changed today?
Why does it matter?
What could it affect?
What should we watch next?
Important data must come from official or industry-recognized sources. Unverified information will never be presented as confirmed fact.
Filter Information. Identify Change.
Less Noise. More Insight. Better Decisions.
All in BOTO DAILY.

When the music fades, the memories remain.

Mixtape Chronicles is a weekly interview show about the songs that became part of who we are—and the memories, relationships, and former versions of ourselves they reconnect us to.

Each guest shares the soundtrack of their life through a carefully curated playlist, using music as the starting point for honest, funny, and deeply human conversations about growing up, finding our way, and becoming the people we are today. Each episode will allow you to time travel—with occasional stops at school dances, sleepovers, and the deeply personal decision of which song deserved Track 1.

But the show isn’t all about the music. It’s about what the music gives us access to: the person we were before life became so busy, complicated, and disconnected. Sometimes, hearing the right song at the right moment is all it takes to bring a forgotten part of ourselves back into focus.

In an on-demand world that constantly reminds us of what divides us, Mixtape Chronicles celebrates the memories, emotions, and experiences that bring us back to ourselves—and closer to one another.

title: The Early Adventures of Don Everhard: A Hard Boiled Gambler's Tale
author: Gordon Young
description:
Don Everhard, a sharp-witted gambler with a talent for deception, steps into a world where every card counts and danger lurks in every corner. In *Early Adventures of Don Everhard*, author Gordon Young introduces listeners to this hard-boiled antihero whose life is a thrilling blend of high-stakes poker and cunning cons. As Everhard navigates the treacherous underbelly of crime, he faces off against ruthless opponents and unexpected allies, all while outsmarting the schemes that threaten to unravel his carefully crafted persona.

These three gripping short stories dive deep into Everhard's early escapades, showcasing his quick reflexes, sharp mind, and an uncanny ability to read people. Each tale unfolds with unexpected twists that will keep you on the edge of your seat—whether he's bluffing at the card table or escaping from a precarious situation.

Listeners will appreciate the rich tapestry of themes woven throughout, from the moral dilemmas of a life built on deception to the thrill of living on the edge. As Everhard's journey unfolds, you'll find yourself questioning what it truly means to play the game of life. Discover the origins of one of crime fiction's pioneering figures and experience the allure of noir storytelling that paved the way for the genre we adore today. Don’t miss your chance to step into the shadows with Don Everhard—where every gamble could be your last.

title: His Word, Her Story
author: His Word, Her Story
description:
His Word, Her Story is a podcast about the intersection of God's Word and the stories He is writing in the lives of women.
Katie sits down with ordinary women to hear how an extraordinary God has worked through seasons of joy, uncertainty, challenge, and growth. These are honest conversations about faith and where God meets us in everyday life.
Katie doesn't have all the answers, but she believes God's Word is living and active and every woman's story can testify to His faithfulness.
Come be encouraged, open Scripture with us, and discover how God is shaping your story too.

title: Rain Magic: Sea Adventure and Romance
author: Erle Stanley Gardner
description:
When a sudden storm shipwrecks him in the Pacific, Ted Marshall finds himself washed ashore on a mysterious island, where danger lurks around every corner. In *Rain Magic*, Erle Stanley Gardner crafts a gripping tale of survival and intrigue, as Ted encounters an island filled with hidden treasures, enigmatic inhabitants, and secrets that could change his life forever. With each twist and turn, he must navigate treacherous landscapes and deceptive alliances while uncovering the island's dark past.

Driven by the desire to escape and return home, Ted's journey transforms into a quest for truth and redemption. The island's allure captivates him, but so do the complex relationships he forms with its residents. As Ted delves deeper into their world, he must confront not only external threats but also his own fears and desires.

*Rain Magic* immerses listeners in a whirlwind of action and adventure, exploring themes of courage, love, and the unpredictable nature of fate. Each decision takes Ted closer to uncovering the island's greatest mystery—one that could either save him or seal his doom. Will he unlock the secrets that lie beneath the surface, or will the island claim him as its own? Join Ted on this unforgettable journey and discover the magic that rain can bring.

title: Group Leaders Podcast

description:
Whether you're leading your first small group or your fifteenth, this podcast is designed to help you lead with greater confidence and intentionality. You'll learn practical strategies for creating healthy group environments, asking better questions, navigating challenging group dynamics, choosing the right content, fostering authentic community, and helping people take their next step in following Jesus. 
Each episode combines practical leadership insights, real-life stories, and North Point Ministries' proven small group strategy to better equip you before your next small group meeting.

title: The Time Dissolver: Memory and Identity
author: Jerry Sohl
description:
Waking up in a dingy motel room beside a stunning woman he doesn’t recognize, David is thrust into a bewildering reality where eleven years have vanished from his memory. In *Time Dissolver* by Jerry Sohl, David grapples with a chilling truth: crucial moments from history—the Korean War, the rise of Eisenhower, and Stalin's death—have slipped through his fingers. As he delves deeper into his missing years, David uncovers a dark conspiracy that could unravel everything he thought he knew about himself and the world around him.

Why did he lose nearly a decade of his life? Who is the woman beside him, and what role does she play in this perplexing puzzle? Every clue he unearths leads him further into a web of deceit and danger, as he faces a choice that could reshape his very existence.

Join David on this gripping journey of self-discovery and intrigue, where the stakes are high and the truth is a double-edged sword. *Time Dissolver* challenges the very fabric of memory and identity, inviting listeners to ponder the consequences of what we choose to forget. Will David reclaim his lost years, or will he become just another casualty in a scheme far larger than himself? Tune in for a mind-bending adventure that will keep you guessing until the last moment.

title: Classic Song Chats

He also dug out 5-6 archive interviews done for an ITV pilot that never happened. As a journalist, fillmmaker, anorak and songwriter/musician he covers everything from inspiration to fame, synths to royalties.

title: The Mystery of Black Rock Creek: A Collaborative Tale of Intrigue
author: Edward  F. Benson
description:
When a dying man gasps out a cryptic warning about hidden diamonds and a conspiracy to murder, the peaceful town of Black Rock Creek is turned upside down. In this captivating audiobook, *The Mystery of Black Rock Creek*, E. F. Benson and an ensemble of renowned authors—including Jerome K. Jerome and Eden Phillpotts—craft a round robin tale filled with intrigue and suspense. Each chapter reveals a new layer of mystery, as eccentric characters and ghostly visitations intertwine to unravel a plot that goes far beyond mere greed.

As secrets surface and alliances shift, listeners will find themselves questioning the motives of everyone involved. Who can be trusted when the stakes are so high? The central conflict revolves around the search for truth against a backdrop of deception and betrayal, keeping listeners on the edge of their seats. With its mix of humor, weird fiction, and classic mystery elements, each twist draws you deeper into the enigma surrounding Black Rock Creek.

Join this thrilling journey where every character holds a piece of the puzzle. Will you uncover the truth before it’s too late? Delve into this unique collaboration and experience a rich tapestry of storytelling that promises to entertain and challenge your perception of loyalty and ambition. Perfect for fans of classic crime fiction, this audiobook invites you to solve the mystery alongside its unforgettable cast.

title: National Fire Training

title: Jazz: The Evolution of a Cultural Fusion
author: Raymond P. Jones
description:
The birth of jazz wasn't just a musical evolution; it was a revolution born from the struggles and triumphs of a community. In "Jazz," R. P. Jones delves into the rich tapestry of sounds that emerged as African rhythms collided with European melodies, crafting a genre that would forever change the landscape of music. This audiobook takes you on a captivating journey through the late 19th century, revealing how societal forces—religious, economic, and artistic—shaped this vibrant art form.

Explore the pivotal moments that influenced jazz's development, from the underground clubs of New Orleans to the grand stages of Harlem. Understand how individual musicians, with their unique stories and struggles, contributed to a genre that became a voice for many. Each chapter unravels the complex dynamics of cultural exchange and artistic expression, inviting listeners to consider the deeper themes of identity, resilience, and innovation.

As you listen, you'll encounter the legends whose improvisations pushed boundaries and the movements that sparked change within the music world. "Jazz" is not just an exploration; it's an invitation to feel the heartbeat of a genre that continues to inspire artists and audiences alike. Join R. P. Jones as he uncovers the secrets and stories behind the music that transcends time.

From husbands who treat wives like free secretaries with dental benefits, to in-laws who think love has a rulebook, nothing is safe from the roast. title: The Hairy Ones Shall Dance: Terror in the Devil’s Croft
author: Manly Wade Wellman
description:
When a seemingly innocent séance spirals into a nightmarish encounter, the residents of Devil's Croft find themselves grappling with a horror that defies explanation. In 'Hairy Ones Shall Dance,' Manly Wade Wellman weaves a chilling tale of spectral forces and dark secrets that lurk just beneath the surface of their quiet community. As the veil between the living and the dead thins, the participants of the séance awaken a malevolent presence, leading to terror, madness, and unexpected deaths.

Follow the gripping journey of those who dare to confront the unseen, as they uncover the sinister history of the land and the horrifying truth behind the Hairy Ones. This audiobook delves into themes of fear, the supernatural, and the age-old struggle between light and darkness. Each twist and turn pulls listeners deeper into the mystery, raising questions about what lies beyond our understanding.

With Wellman’s masterful storytelling, listeners will experience the raw emotion and palpable tension of a community on the brink. Can they unravel the enigma before it's too late, or will they succumb to the horrors that dance just out of sight? Prepare for a gripping exploration of dread and discovery that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Perfect for fans of supernatural fiction and horror, 'Hairy Ones Shall Dance' invites you to confront your own fears and the mysteries that linger in the shadows.

title: Learn OCD
author: Natasha Moharter
description:
Welcome to the podcast that dives deep into the world of Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) with compassion, expertise, and a mission to educate and empower. I'm Natasha Moharter, a licensed counselor and OCD specialist, and I'm here to guide you through the complexities of OCD to help you gain a deeper understanding of this often-misunderstood condition.
Whether you're a professional in the mental health field or someone who's personally affected by OCD, this podcast is for you. OCD is often misunderstood, and its impact on individuals and families can be profound. That's why it's crucial to shed light on this often-misunderstood condition and explore the nuances of its presentation.
Each episode, we'll dive deep into various aspects of OCD, from its symptoms and diagnosis to the latest treatment options. We'll discuss the latest research findings and practical strategies for managing OCD in everyday life. By understanding OCD better, we can reduce stigma, increase access to quality treatment, and ultimately improve the lives of those affected by this disorder.
Join me on this journey as we navigate the complexities of OCD together. Whether you're seeking answers, support, or simply a deeper understanding, "Learn OCD" is your go-to resource for all things OCD. Subscribe now and start your journey to understanding and change.

title: The Maker's Signal

description: The Maker’s Signal is a podcast about faith, creativity, and technology—and what happens when you stop treating those parts of your life like they have to stay separate. Hosted by Benjamin Liles, the show explores songwriting, books, AI, programming, creative projects, personal stories, and Christian faith from the perspective of an independent creator who is still learning, building, and making what matters.

title: Cue for Quiet: The Power of a Cure
author: Thomas L. Sherred
description:
When a relentless headache drives scientist Martin Sykes to the brink of despair, he stumbles upon a groundbreaking discovery: a cure that not only alleviates his pain but also unlocks unimaginable cognitive power. In 'Cue for Quiet,' Thomas L. Sherred plunges listeners into a thrilling journey through the mind’s uncharted territories, where the lines between genius and madness blur. As Martin grapples with his newfound abilities, he faces a chilling dilemma: how much power is too much?

This gripping tale explores the depths of human potential, the ethical implications of enhanced intelligence, and the unforeseen consequences of playing god. As Martin's intellect expands, so does his isolation; former friends become wary, and dark forces lurk in the shadows, eager to exploit his discovery. Can he hold onto his humanity as he navigates this treacherous landscape?

Perfect for fans of classic science fiction and those intrigued by the possibilities of the human mind, 'Cue for Quiet' invites you to question the limits of knowledge and the price of power. Join Martin on this captivating journey where each chapter uncovers new mysteries and challenges that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to find out what happens when a simple cure spirals into a complex web of ambition, fear, and the quest for control.

description:
What It Actually Felt Like
Real stories from people changing their relationship with alcohol

Changing your relationship with alcohol is rarely straightforward. It is not linear, it is not always dramatic, and it does not look the same for everyone. What It Actually Felt Like is a series of honest, personal stories from people who have been through it, reflecting on the moments, realisations and turning points that shaped their journey.

Each episode focuses on a specific stage of the process: the early days when alcohol seems to be everywhere, the social situations that felt loaded, the difficult moments that almost derailed everything, and the quiet shifts that made things feel possible again. These are not polished success stories. They are honest accounts of what it actually felt like from the inside.

The series is part of 100 Days Your Way, a behaviour change programme from Alcohol Change UK designed to help people better understand and gradually take control of their relationship with alcohol. 100 Days Your Way is not a challenge or an abstinence programme. It is a 100-day guided experiment built around how habits actually work and how people genuinely change over time.


Whether you are at the start of your own journey or somewhere in the middle, you will find something in these episodes that feels familiar. And sometimes, hearing someone else describe exactly what you are going through is the most useful thing of all.

 Find out more about 100 Days Your Way at alcoholchange.org.uk

title: GRACE Works
author: Paul Crick
description:
You can usually tell when pressure has started to change you. The conversation that would have taken ten minutes last year now takes three emails and a meeting. You are shorter with people you like. You catch yourself listening for the end of someone's sentence rather than the sense of it.
GRACEWorks is a podcast about our capacity to relate. To each other, and to ourselves, and particularly under pressure, whether that pressure arrived by accident, came from outside, or is something we have quietly done to ourselves.
If you have built something, you will know a particular version of this. You hired well. You meant to step back. And still the hard calls land on your desk, everything comes back to you, and the business keeps growing while leadership feels increasingly stretched.
That is rarely a talent problem. What usually happens is that complexity grows faster than the ways people have learned to work together. The organisation has not yet learned to carry what growth is asking of it, so you carry it instead.
Underneath that sits an older and simpler question, and it is the one this podcast is really about. How do people become more capable together? Not how to become a better leader, or a tougher individual, or a higher performer. How do we cultivate, between us, the capacities that let us think, decide, disagree and carry more than any of us could alone? Trust, judgement and shared responsibility are not installed. We grow them between people, usually under pressure.
Each episode is an unhurried conversation with someone who has thought seriously about that. What trust actually rests on. How people learn. What happens to judgement when the stakes rise. How we find our way back to each other after we have got it wrong. Organisations turn up often, because they are one of the richest places to watch human beings under load. But they are the laboratory here, not the subject. The subject is always human.
This is not motivation. It's not productivity hacks. And it's not another mindset podcast telling you to push through.
Your plan and pitch deck say one thing. Real life seems to say something different. These conversations sit with that gap rather than trying to talk you out of it.
If more decisions return to you than move away from you. If you are tired of managing pressure by brute force. If success has come at the cost of ease, meaning, or your health. If you want to build something that can carry more without losing what made it work in the first place. And if you would rather hear people think out loud than be told what to do, this is for you.
Hosted by Paul Crick. Twenty years alongside organisations of every size, many more practising Aikido, and a long habit of watching closely and being slow to assume. GRACEWorks is part of The Elevate Partnership.
Questions before answers, mostly. Find an hour and come and think alongside us.

title: An Earthenware Mug, a 1942 Bomb Crater, an Industrially Reinforced Piano, and Geoff queer Music Therapy
author: Geoffa Fells
description:
To manage the extremely painful emotions arising in response to the ableist, pathologising, classist, heteronormative and racist content in music therapy training, I wrote my essays as consecutive scenes of a play - now 4 scenes! Child development, attachment theory, relational dynamics and therapeutic approaches are all queered via an intersectionally anti-oppressive lens by neurodivergent characters. The narrative opens with a neuroqueer family in North London, heads out to the International Space Station and concludes with a Whodunnit set in IKEA.


Weeks in to my studies, it was noted by the tutors that some of the music therapy course content was actively harmful to me as a trans non-binary, autistic, disabled person from a working class background... "in order to best include you, we don't think you should come in" said my head of department. Queer people face many barriers in accessing queer-affirming therapy and these barriers are rooted in the barriers faced by queer people training in therapy. I'm hoping that my play will generate awareness and discussion around this.

title: Catholic Convos Podcast
author: pauliedamato
description:
Faith is often presented as something we’re supposed to have all the answers to. But what happens when we have questions? What happens when we doubt, struggle, disagree, or simply don’t understand?

This podcast is a place for those questions.

Our goal is to create honest, respectful, and meaningful conversations about Catholicism, Christianity, faith, doubt, and the questions that people sometimes feel uncomfortable asking out loud. We believe that asking questions doesn’t make someone a bad Catholic—or a bad Christian. In many cases, asking questions can be the beginning of a deeper understanding of what we believe and why we believe it.

Throughout the podcast, we’ll explore questions from many different perspectives. We’ll talk about the questions atheists and non-believers have about Catholicism, as well as the doubts that Catholics themselves may quietly wrestle with. We’ll discuss difficult topics, examine Church teachings, and take a closer look at the reasons behind the Catholic faith.

And most importantly, we want to have these conversations honestly.

Our hope is not to tell people what they are allowed to ask or what they are supposed to think. Instead, we want to create a space where curiosity is welcomed, doubts can be discussed, and faith can be explored without fear of judgment.

With guests such as Father Meinders, we’ll have conversations that encourage listeners to think deeply, challenge their assumptions, and perhaps even see their faith from a different perspective.

Whether you are a practicing Catholic, someone who has walked away from the Church, someone who is questioning your beliefs, an atheist who wants to understand Catholicism, or simply someone who has always had questions, you are welcome here.

Because sometimes the questions we’re most afraid to ask are the ones worth asking the most.

Listen. Question. Explore. Believe—or wrestle with what you believe.

There are no perfect questions, and there may not always be simple answers. But there is always room for an honest conversation.

title: Stoicism

description:
Stoic Living is the art of mastering oneself in a world that cannot be mastered. It is not about suppressing emotions, but about understanding them—about learning to respond instead of react. A person who lives stoically moves through life with a calm strength, grounded in the awareness that while we cannot control external events, we can always control our judgments, choices, and actions.

To live stoically is to accept reality as it is, without resistance or bitterness. It means recognizing that pain, loss, and change are part of the natural order, and that peace comes not from avoiding them, but from embracing them with courage and clarity. The Stoic does not chase pleasure or flee discomfort, but seeks balance and purpose in all things. Every challenge becomes an opportunity to practice virtue—to be wise when it’s easier to be ignorant, patient when it’s tempting to rush, kind when it would be simpler to be cruel.

Stoic living invites a person to find freedom not in circumstances, but in character. It teaches us that happiness is not found in possessions or praise, but in integrity, discipline, and gratitude for the present moment. In the stillness of Stoic living, one learns that true strength is quiet, that peace is an inner fortress, and that the only real power any of us have lies in how we choose to meet the world each day—with reason, resilience, and grace.

title: The War in Between
author: Richard L Burr
description:
The War in Between
In 1990, Congress set up a commission to study every major fight of the Civil War — three hundred eighty-four fields in all — and rank each one by how much it actually weighed on the war. Class A. Class B. You already know most of those: Gettysburg, Antietam, Vicksburg.
The War in Between stays entirely in Class C: real fights, real ground, almost none of it known outside the county it happened in. A Union general who broke his own standing orders and missed an entire brigade hiding in the trees three days before Bull Run. A sitting governor who personally commanded troops in a battle — the only time in American history that's happened. A herd of wild horses, mistaken in the dark for enemy cavalry, on a beach in Florida.
Episodes run in strict order, one year at a time, coast to coast — Virginia one week, Missouri or Kansas the next — because the war didn't happen in one place at a time, and neither does this show. If you already know the big campaigns, this is the thread that ties them together: the days you skipped on your way to the days everyone else knows by heart.
Every episode ends the same way.
Know this ground.

What lights you up - and what have you stopped making space for?

For years as a journalist, I had a front-row seat to extraordinary lives, lifting the lid on what made other people shine. Making people feel seen comes naturally to me. Seeing myself? Not so much.

When life knocked the stuffing out of me, survival mode showed up as me disappearing. My world got very small, and so did I. But my story isn't over. I am done just existing.

The Nerve of You is me coming out of hiding and having the nerve to find my voice at 56. It’s a playful experiment. It could be messy, it could be raw, it could be exactly the tonic you need and it’s very likely to be random as the real me returns and the jitters wear off. As long as I’m enjoying the process and feeling alive, that’s hitting the jackpot.

Perfectionism isn't invited, but you are. Join me in making space for what lights you up and makes you feel fully alive.

On this show, we’re exploring:

  • Curiosity over Perfection: Learning to play, experiment, and come out of hiding

  • Identity: Owning the truth that there’s nothing wrong with you (except your thinking that there is)

  • Nervous System Supports: Creative ways to build new responses and cultivate an inner ease as you become visible

  • The Magic of Fascia Release: Melting holding patterns in the body to create physical, mental, and emotional space

  • Plant-Fueled Living: Delicious plant-based meals, treats made with natural sugars and DIY skincare your body loves

So, if you’re ready to set your Supporting Role Oscar down and make space for you and all your fabulous idiosyncrasies, you’re in the right place.

Grab a cuppa and hit subscribe, let’s see where this takes us.
